hypothesis: Same training as preset D: short iterative fine-tunes of the run-1 best state on the operator's complete Mumie photos, mixed 4:8 with 777 training photos at a small learning rate and with the full preset-B augmentations, inside the same third-run budget. Rules revision adopted after iteration 1 of preset D was observed (D-490): a state is admissible when its level-B 777 development photos stay complete and correct within 0.5 percentage points of run 1, its overall 777 development image-macro is not worse than run 1's and it detects every board without false boards; among admissible states the lowest Mumie-holdout image-macro is chosen.

metrics.false_board: prediction whose quad IoU with every label is below 0.5
metrics.image_macro: T05: per label min(1, NME), missing or invalid = 1, mean per photo, mean over photos
metrics.matching: hungarian-max-quad-iou; pairs below min IoU are not matched
metrics.normalization: euclidean distance of label nodes 0 and 23 (TL-BR diagonal, as T05)
metrics.photo_complete_correct: every label board matched and correct and no false board
metrics.selection: max photo_complete_correct_rate on development; tie -> lower image_macro; tie -> earlier round
